summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with a B.E. in Electronics and Telecommunication. Hands on experience with embedded C on STM32 Cortex M4 microcontrollers, including direct GPIO, timer, and I2C peripheral programming, PCB design and fabrication in EAGLE, and hardware debugging with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers. Built UART and I2C sensor integrations, FreeRTOS based task coordination, and Python tooling for hardware automation and testing across robotics and embedded projects.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed loop feedback.
Led a 25 member robotics team across national level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition glove for hands free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC 05 Bluetooth to translate 3 DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap detection algorithm using z axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) - MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux across a Jetson and Arduino hardware pipeline.
Implemented two link inverse kinematics on Arduino in embedded C++; drove five servos with range gated contact detection.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare metal embedded C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) on a Cortex M4 microprocessor; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate, verified in Proteus.
Implemented timer triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt driven sample capture, and a low level I2C driver for real time sensing and display.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi servo PWM control with interrupt driven UART commands and user override.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop - Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
